one_liner: Grass_V3 creates a configurable particle system of grass and flowers with clustering, random placement, and wind animation.
primary_use_case: Procedural generation of grass and flower clusters in a 3D scene.
preview_recommendation: The preview PNG shows a lush field of grass with scattered flowers, illustrating the clustering and wind animation; use it to gauge visual quality.
manifest_quality_notes: Config UI defaults differ from v2 defaults
High clone counts may affect performance
No explicit error handling for missing models
App uses app.configure for UI inputs
